name: Smart Post PDF – Export Blog Posts to PDF
author: Akram ul haq

sections.description:
Post to PDF lets you add a “Download as PDF” button to WordPress posts. Visitors can download the full content of your blog posts in a clean, styled PDF format.

  • Choose from 3 layout templates
  • Set button position (before/after post)
  • Align button left, center, or right
  • Enable/disable with a simple checkbox

Perfect for tutorials, case studies, documentation, and printable blog content.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/
  2. Activate through the “Plugins” menu
  3. Go to Settings > Post to PDF to configure
sections.faq:
Can I use this with custom post types?

Not in the free version. The Pro version will support CPTs.

Can I customize the PDF layout?

Yes, the plugin includes 3 templates. You can also override them in your theme.
